The module pages reproduce the exports and signatures in `types/neo-js.d.ts`, including types that do not exist at runtime.

A declaration does not grant access. See [Host permissions and module access](/runtime/permissions/) for permission flags, conditional exports, and module allowlists.

## Globals

[Public host globals](/api/globals/), including `console`, which is not in the current declaration file.
